title: Layer 3  -  The Teaching Layer: Law Organization

canonical_node.axiom: The teaching layer is a negotiable human-facing organization of the ten formal factors, which must always reduce cleanly to Layer 1 (formal) and Layer 2 (physical-theological mathematics) without contradiction.
definitions: Formal factor: a typed mathematical object in Definition 10, fixed at ten.
Teaching law chapter: a human-facing explanatory unit, numbering 9 or 10, negotiable.
Three-layer reconciliation: a test requiring that any public claim reduces to a Layer 2 pairing, that pairing reduces to a Layer 1 factor, and that factor has a verified property in the Lean kernel.
derivation: Layer 1 fixes ten formal factors; Layer 2 pairs them with spiritual readings; Layer 3 organizes them into teaching chapters.
Teaching chapters may consolidate or split factors without changing the formal count, as long as each chapter reduces to Layer 1 and Layer 2.
The current best sequence consolidates old Law 8 into Law 1, clusters Q/R/T into Law 7, and adds Wolfram's pairings as corollaries.
Three laws (1, 7, 9) are identified as asymmetric anchors forming a flow structure; six are symmetric carriers; Law 10 integrates.
The no-drift rule requires that teaching never contradicts Layer 1, always reduces to Layer 2, marks simplifications, and keeps teaching law count at 9 or 10.
canonical_node.action: When producing any public-facing explanation, ensure it reduces to a Layer 2 pairing and a Layer 1 factor, and mark any simplifications explicitly.
boundary: Does not alter Layer 1 or Layer 2; those are non-negotiable.
Does not fix the number of teaching laws at 10; it may be 9 or 10.
Does not resolve open items such as slot 8 or the status of HonorFrame Integrity.
test: For any claim: Does it reduce to a Layer 2 pairing Does that pairing reduce to a Layer 1 factor Does that factor have a verified property in the Lean kernel
If any answer is no, drift has occurred and must be fixed before publication.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a human-facing organization that consolidates formal factors into teaching chapters, enabling communication to diverse audiences without altering the formal layer.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ten formal factors and the Layer 2 pairings; teaching organization is negotiable but must reduce cleanly.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this layer, the framework remains formally intact but becomes less communicable; the teaching organization is not essential to the formal truth.
dg5_translation_registers: Teaching law chapter -> Layer 1 factor (via reduction)

classification.recommended_atom_action: record as negotiable teaching organization; do not treat as formal proof

overstatement_risks: Claiming the teaching sequence is canonical when it is proposed and negotiable.
Treating the three asymmetric anchors as structurally proven rather than an observation.
Implying Wolfram's pairings are formally verified when they are only folded in as corollaries.
kill_conditions: If a teaching chapter implies a factor merge, split, or chi-as-factor, the teaching is wrong.
If a teaching pairing cannot be derived from the ten-row table, it is invalid.
If the teaching law count becomes 8 or 11, the organization is invalid.
risk.lean_target: No Lean target; this is a teaching organization, not a formal theorem.

plain_summary: This document proposes a negotiable teaching layer that organizes the ten formal factors into 9 or 10 human-facing law chapters, with the requirement that all teaching reduce cleanly to the formal and physical-theological layers. It is not a formal proof and should be treated as a proposal.
